patient._volume_filter_note: Skip levels below the 20-session value area or in a thin volume zone (research 2026-11-22: +0.007R vs +0.331R on 9,877 practice trades, both halves, 85% of tickers).

sync.pulse_filter_note: No NEW buys while the 10-stock basket is below its 70-hour average (research: drawdowns -46%->-14% yr1, -32%->-20% yr2, but yr2 return +21.8%->+6.5%). Open trades and stops unaffected.

trio_note: Lineup since 2026-11-20: the nuclear fuel chain, 10 stocks, 3 trades at a time. Mine: CCJ NXE UEC DNN UUUU. Enrich: LEU. Build/fuel parts: BWXT. Burn: CEG VST TLN.

owner_posts.note: Owner posts arrive on ntfy topic <NTFY_TOPIC>-inbox. They make the team scan now; they never bypass the support/stop rules.

hawk.note: Always-on VM only: live trades from Alpaca's free data feed wake the bot on a target touch, a stop-zone touch or a fast move; news fast lane every minute, slow lane every 10.

huddle.note: Free talk, but only when something changed (fast move, price near a waiting buy, a fill or exit, big news) plus one midday check. Cheapest model only; daily $ cap still applies. Talk can skip a waiting buy or exit on bad news; it can never buy.

research_lab.note: After each daily review and Saturday 10am: agents propose ideas, code tests them on practice trades in two halves, critic reviews, notes saved. Never changes trading by itself.

paper_unleashed.note: Paper only (switches off automatically on a LIVE broker): no fixed number of trades (as many as setups and cash allow, each ~20% of the account), no sector filter, huddles and research whenever there's something new, no daily agent cap. The only number left is the monthly $ ceiling, because it's real money.

intel._note: Free local + official news collector (collector.py) and NRC reactor watch (reactors.py). No AI. Reddit only if REDDIT_CLIENT_ID and REDDIT_SECRET secrets exist.

panic_rebound._note: Strategy #2. Buys between 3:30 and 3:58 pm ET on a market panic day; needs a run in that window (the always-on computer). On a LIVE broker it obeys the promotion gate and loss brakes.
panic_rebound._size_note: Size per stock adapts: rule picks a step from VIX (under 25 or 40+ = stronger) and the stock's drop (8%+ = stronger); the PM can move it one step after the team talks. Tested 2019-2026: $1,000 -> $5,863 (25%/yr, worst drop -23%) vs flat 33% -> $5,018 (-34.5%).
panic_rebound._related_note: Nuclear picks first; empty slots (of 3) go to ~74 related stocks (utilities with reactors, new nuclear, AI/data-center power demand, grid equipment, gas, plant builders, naval/defense, mining), liquid only ($20M+/day, $3+). Tested 2019-2026: 191 trades vs 83, +3.96% avg vs +3.45%, both halves positive; compounding 13.8%/yr vs 8.9% (worst drop -26% vs -19%).
panic_rebound.small_below_200d_note: Research 2026-11-23: the rule lost money 2008-2018 (-2.1%/yr, worst drop -65%). Smallest size while the S&P is under its 200-day average: 2008-2026 9.5%/yr vs 8.5%, worst drop -41% vs -65%; costs ~3.6%/yr in 2019-2026.
panic_rebound.gap_bank_note: Sell a panic-rebound stock right after the open when it opens 5%+ above yesterday's close; buy it back near the close unless the trade ends today. Research 2026-11-23: 2008-18 +0.8%->+3.2%/trade, 2019-26 unchanged. 0 turns it off.

_budget_note: budget_total_usd = all prepaid Claude credit ($5 + $5 added Nov 23 2026 = $10) minus a safety margin; monthly cap $10. When a cap is reached the agents go quiet and the rules keep trading. Raise both when credit is added.

auto_trade._note: Paper: patterns that pass the discovery engine act on their own. Relative up-patterns (beat the basket) raise that stock's next support-buy size 1.5x for the horizon; sector up-patterns buy CCJ near the close; down-patterns pause support buys in that stock.

conviction._note: Paper: the team's own calls from news + desk notes (not a tested rule). Size = 30% x conviction/10 x record multiplier (0.5-2x after 5 trades). Own stop/target/days; every trade scored.

parking._note: Idle cash goes into SPY near the close and is sold on demand when any trade needs it. Tested with the panic rule 2019-2026: 37%/yr vs 25% with cash idle; worst drop -31% vs -23%.
parking.trend_note: Research 2026-11-24 (park_trend_leverage): SSO above the S&P 200-day average, T-bills below: 2007-26 13.0%/yr vs 10.5% SPY, worst drop -40% vs -55%; better in 2007-18 (10.2 vs 7.0) and 2019-26 (17.5 vs 16.1). mode 'spy' = old behaviour.
parking.keep_cash_note: 10% stays in cash (was 3%) so after-hours dip buys can be funded after the close, when the parked fund cannot be sold with a market order.

options_spec._note: Practice book: real put prices, no money. Bearish triggers proven by research only (offerings first).

sharp_drop.note: Any-day rebound after a 15%+ fall over 5 sessions (nuclear + related). Research 2026-11-23: beat the S&P by +0.84%/trade 2008-18 and +1.09% 2019-26, about 1 trade a week.

add.note: Second buy (same dollars, once) when an open sharp-drop trade falls another 10%. Research 2026-11-24: sharp_drop_add.

sharp_drop.tier2_note: Research 2026-11-24 (sharp_drop_wide): whole-account backtest 2008-26 with all rules: adding these 140 big stocks as a second tier (same 3 slots, nuclear + related first) 25.2%/yr vs 23.2% (2008-18 17.7 vs 17.5, 2019-26 36.3 vs 31.5), worst drop -40.5% vs -40.7%; without the 10 biggest winners 24.2%/yr (18.3/32.8), worst -38.6%. 4 or 5 slots did worse. Survivorship caveat: today's big companies.

signal_trades.note: AI power day (NVIDIA +6% -> CEG/VST/TLN for 5 sessions) and fear fading (VIX>30 down 2 days -> lineup for 20 sessions). Research 2026-11-23: cross_market_signals.

holiday_trades.note: Thanksgiving run-up (Tue close -> Black Friday close) and Black Friday exit for trades due within 3 sessions. Research 2026-11-23: thanksgiving_trades.

comeback.note: Intraday comeback (low 6%+ under yesterday's close, back above it near the close) -> hold 20 sessions. Research 2026-11-24: intraday_comeback.

account_brake.note: Half size on every new trade while the account is 25%+ below its peak. Research 2026-11-24: account_drawdown_brake.

year_end_wide.note: Research 2026-11-24 (year_end_wide): 5 worst YTD among related + big stocks, buy ~Dec 18-20, sell ~Jan 15. Related +0.73%/+5.34% vs S&P (2008-18/2019-25, t 0.3/1.5), big stocks +3.38%/+3.53% (t 1.8/1.2), beat S&P in 9/12 and 6/7 years. Small size: one trade a year, thin evidence.

earnings_pop.note: Research 2026-11-25 (earnings_pop_drift): +8%+ earnings reaction day, buy the next close, hold 20 sessions: +3.39%/+6.43% vs S&P (2008-18/2019-26), beat 65%/71%, 41 cases across CCJ, MU, NVDA, ETN.

ah_dip.note: Research 2026-11-25 (after_hours_dip): AH 3%+ under the 4 PM close on 1%+ of the day volume, buy at the AH price, sell 9:35 next day: +1.84%/+1.47% per trade after 1% cost (2016-18/2019-26), all 7 names positive.
